correctness.rationale: The published vertex formula splits each vertex into two permutation position vectors plus one distinguished unit coordinate in each block. The source harmonic condition partitions all other labels into a, b, c classes and gives p+q=n+1+b for the distinguished positions. The centered permutation second moment is n(n^2-1)/12, yielding the exact shell square. The published enumeration grouped by fixed b gives the stated multiplicity. The outer-shell equal-weight barycenter is exactly the uniform affine point, so the parallel-axis identity proves both minimum-enclosing optimality and uniqueness; strict shell separation proves the exact contact set.

value.rationale: The harmonic polytope is a canonical recent polytope arising from the Lagrangian geometry of matroids, with a highly nontrivial vertex set of size (n!)^2 H_n. The theorem compresses that vertex set into exactly n Euclidean radius classes, gives every multiplicity, and identifies the source's purely order-theoretic before/before statistic as a metric coordinate with constant squared-radius spacing. The exact outer shell then gives a closed circumradius and a complete contact classification. This is a family-wide structural metric theorem rather than a routine low-dimensional computation.
